example_zh: 他们将产品出口到世界各地的市场。

definition: held or fixed in position securely; difficult to move, open or separate
example: He kept a tight grip on her arm.
definition_zh: 牢固地固定或固定在原位；难以移动、打开或分离
example_zh: 他紧紧抓着她的胳膊。

definition: until
example: We're open till 6 o'clock.
definition_zh: 直到
example_zh: 我们营业到6点。

definition: until
example: We're open till 6 o'clock.
definition_zh: 直到
example_zh: 我们营业到6点。

definition: a metal container in which food is sold; the contents of one of these containers
example: Open the tin and drain the tuna.
definition_zh: 一种用于出售食品的金属容器；此类容器中装有的食物
example_zh: 打开罐头，将金枪鱼沥干。

definition: very small in size or amount
example: a tiny baby
definition_zh: 体积或数量非常小
example_zh: 一个小小的婴儿

definition: to give somebody an extra amount of money to thank them for something they have done for you as part of their job
example: Americans were always welcome because they tended to tip heavily.
definition_zh: 为了感谢某人履行工作职责时为你所做的事，而额外给其一笔钱
example_zh: 美国人总是备受欢迎，因为他们通常会给大额小费。

definition: one of the five small parts that stick out from the foot; any similar part on the foot of an animal or bird
example: the big/little toe (= the largest/smallest toe)
definition_zh: 从脚上伸出的五个小突起之一；动物或鸟类脚上任何类似的部位
example_zh: 大脚趾/小脚趾（即最大的脚趾/最小的脚趾）

definition: the soft part in the mouth that moves around, used for tasting, swallowing, speaking, etc.
example: He clicked his tongue to attract their attention.
definition_zh: 口腔内那个会活动的软组织，用于品尝、吞咽、说话等。
example_zh: 他咂了咂嘴，想引起他们的注意。

definition: being the amount or number after everyone or everything is counted or added together
example: Their total cost was $18 000.
definition_zh: 指在将所有人或所有事物都统计或相加后的总数或数量
example_zh: 总费用为18 000美元。

definition: the amount you get when you add several numbers or amounts together; the final number of people or things when they have all been counted
example: a total of something, You got 47 points on the written examination and 18 on the oral, making a total of 65.
definition_zh: 将几个数字或数量相加后得到的数值；在将所有人和事物都统计完毕后的最终数量
example_zh: 总分是……，你的笔试得了47分，口试得了18分，总分是65分。

definition: completely
example: They come from totally different cultures.
definition_zh: 完全地
example_zh: 他们来自截然不同的文化背景。

definition: the sense that enables you to be aware of things and what they are like when you put your hands and fingers on them
example: the sense of touch
definition_zh: 一种感觉，它能让你在用手和手指触摸事物时，感知到这些事物及其状态
example_zh: 触觉

definition: to travel around a place, for example on holiday, or to perform, to advertise something, etc.
example: tour something, He toured America with his one-man show.
definition_zh: 为了游览某地（例如度假），或者为了演出、宣传某事等。
example_zh: 巡演某项活动，他带着自己的独角戏在美国进行了巡演。

definition: the activity of buying and selling or of exchanging goods or services between people or countries
example: international/foreign/global/world trade
definition_zh: 个人或国家之间买卖或交换商品或服务的活动
example_zh: 国际/国外/全球/世界贸易

definition: to buy and sell things
example: trade in something, The firm openly traded in arms.
definition_zh: 买卖东西
example_zh: 从事某项贸易，该公司公开从事武器贸易。

definition: to express the meaning of speech or writing in a different language
example: translate something into something, He translated the letter into English.
definition_zh: 用另一种语言表达口头或书面语言的含义
example_zh: 将某物翻译成某物，他把这封信翻译成了英语。

definition: the process of changing something that is written or spoken into another language
example: an error in translation
definition_zh: 将书面或口头表达的内容转换为另一种语言的过程
example_zh: 翻译错误

definition: to take something/somebody from one place to another in a vehicle
example: to transport goods/passengers
definition_zh: 用车辆将某物/某人从一处运送到另一处
example_zh: 运输货物/乘客

definition: to behave in a particular way towards somebody/something
example: treat somebody/something with something, to treat people with respect
definition_zh: 对某人/某事表现出某种特定的态度
example_zh: 以……对待某人/某物，即以尊重的态度对待他人

definition: something that is done to cure an illness or injury, or to make somebody look and feel good
example: The drug is used in the treatment of depression.
definition_zh: 为治愈疾病或伤痛，或使某人看起来和感觉都很好而采取的措施
example_zh: 该药物用于治疗抑郁症。

definition: a general direction in which a situation is changing or developing
example: social/economic/political/demographic trends
definition_zh: 一种情况正在发生变化或发展的总体方向
example_zh: 社会、经济、政治和人口趋势

definition: something that you do to make somebody believe something that is not true, or to annoy somebody as a joke
example: They had to think of a trick to get past the guards.
definition_zh: 指为了让某人相信某件不真实的事情，或者为了开玩笑而惹恼某人而做出的某种行为
example_zh: 他们不得不想个办法才能躲过守卫的眼睛。

definition: to make somebody believe something which is not true, especially in order to cheat them
example: trick somebody, I'd been tricked and I felt stupid.
definition_zh: 让某人相信某件不真实的事情，尤其是为了欺骗对方
example_zh: 骗了别人，结果我自己却被骗了，觉得自己真蠢。

definition: the true facts about something, rather than the things that have been invented or guessed
example: Do you think she's telling the truth?
definition_zh: 关于某事的真实情况，而不是那些杜撰或猜测的内容
example_zh: 你觉得她说的是实话吗？

definition: a long, hollow pipe made of metal, plastic, rubber, etc., through which liquids or gases move from one place to another
example: He had to be fed through a feeding tube for several months.
definition_zh: 一种由金属、塑料、橡胶等材料制成的长而中空的管道，液体或气体通过它从一处流向另一处
example_zh: 他不得不通过胃管进食好几个月。

definition: to write something using a computer keyboard or typewriter
example: How fast can you type?
definition_zh: 使用电脑键盘或打字机写点东西
example_zh: 你的打字速度有多快？

definition: used to say that something usually happens in the way that you are stating
example: The standard chips are typically used for databases and other business software.
definition_zh: 常用来表示某事通常会像你所说的那样发生
example_zh: 标准芯片通常用于数据库和其他商业软件。

definition: a thick rubber ring that fits around the edge of a wheel of a car, bicycle, etc.
example: a front/rear tyre
definition_zh: 一种厚实的橡胶圈，套在汽车、自行车等车轮的边缘上。
example_zh: 前/后轮胎

definition: unpleasant to look at
example: an ugly face
definition_zh: 看着不舒服
example_zh: 一张丑脸

definition: not having the skill, strength, time, knowledge, etc. to do something
example: a former soldier who has been unable to find work since the war ended
definition_zh: 缺乏做某事所需的技能、能力、时间、知识等
example_zh: 一位自战争结束以来一直找不到工作的退伍军人

definition: not letting you feel physically comfortable; unpleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
example: uncomfortable shoes
definition_zh: 让你在身体上感到不舒服；穿着、坐着等时令人不适。
example_zh: 不舒服的鞋子

definition: clothes that you wear under other clothes and next to the skin
example: I never wear underwear.
definition_zh: 穿在其他衣服里面、紧贴皮肤的衣服
example_zh: 我从来不穿内衣。

definition: without a job although able to work
example: How long have you been unemployed?
definition_zh: 虽然能够工作，但没有工作
example_zh: 你失业多久了？

definition: the fact of a number of people not having a job; the number of people without a job
example: an area of high/low unemployment
definition_zh: 指部分人没有工作这一事实；没有工作的人数
example_zh: 失业率较高/较低的地区

definition: not right or fair according to a set of rules or principles; not treating people equally
example: They had been given an unfair advantage.
definition_zh: 根据一套规则或原则，不正确或不公平；不平等对待他人
example_zh: 他们获得了不公平的优势。

definition: an organization of workers, usually in a particular industry, that exists to protect their interests, improve conditions of work, etc.
example: I've joined the union.
definition_zh: 一个由工人组成的组织，通常属于特定行业，旨在维护工人的权益、改善工作条件等。
example_zh: 我已经加入了工会。

definition: used to say that something can only happen or be true in a particular situation
example: You won't get paid for time off unless you have a doctor's note.
definition_zh: 常用来表示某事只有在特定情况下才会发生或成立
example_zh: 除非有医生开具的证明，否则休假期间不会获得薪酬。

definition: different from a particular person or thing
example: Music is quite unlike any other art form.
definition_zh: 与某人或某物不同
example_zh: 音乐与其他任何艺术形式都截然不同。

definition: not likely to happen; not probable
example: unlikely to do something, The project seemed unlikely to succeed.
definition_zh: 不太可能发生；可能性不大
example_zh: 不太可能做某事，该项目似乎不太可能成功。

definition: not needed; more than is needed
example: They were found guilty of causing unnecessary suffering to animals.
definition_zh: 不需要；超过所需数量
example_zh: 他们被判定犯有对动物造成不必要痛苦的罪行。

definition: not pleasant or comfortable
example: an unpleasant experience/surprise/task
definition_zh: 既不愉快也不舒服
example_zh: 一次不愉快的经历/意外/任务

definition: a report or broadcast that gives the most recent information about something; a new version of something containing the most recent information
example: They will send you regular updates by email.
definition_zh: 关于某事的报道或广播，提供有关该事的最新信息；包含最新信息的某事物的最新版本
example_zh: 他们会定期通过电子邮件向您发送最新消息。

definition: to make something more modern by adding new parts, etc.
example: an updated version of the app
definition_zh: 通过添加新部件等方式，使某物更现代化。
example_zh: 该应用的更新版本

definition: on or onto something; used especially in formal language
example: Once upon a time, there lived a king.
definition_zh: 在……上或到……上；尤用于正式场合
example_zh: 从前，有一位国王。

definition: unhappy or disappointed because of something unpleasant that has happened
example: I understand how upset you must be feeling.
definition_zh: 因发生了一些不愉快的事情而感到不高兴或失望
example_zh: 我理解你此刻一定非常难过。

definition: to make somebody/yourself feel unhappy, anxious or annoyed
example: upset somebody/yourself, This decision is likely to upset a lot of people.
definition_zh: 使某人/自己感到不高兴、焦虑或恼火
example_zh: 让某人/自己感到不快，这一决定很可能会让很多人感到不快。

definition: familiar with something because you do it or experience it often
example: used to doing something, I'm not used to eating so much at lunchtime.
definition_zh: 因为经常做某事或经历某事，所以对它很熟悉
example_zh: 习惯了做某件事，但我还不习惯午饭吃那么多。

definition: worth a lot of money
example: My home is my most valuable asset.
definition_zh: 价值不菲
example_zh: 我的房子是我最宝贵的资产。

definition: how much something is worth in money or other goods for which it can be exchanged
example: to go up/rise/increase in value
definition_zh: 某物在金钱或其他可与之交换的物品中的价值
example_zh: 上涨/上升/升值

definition: several different
example: various types/forms/kinds of somebody/something
definition_zh: 几种不同的
example_zh: 某人/某物的各种类型/形式/种类

definition: a form of something that is slightly different from an earlier form or from other forms of the same thing
example: version of something, the latest version of the software package
definition_zh: 某事物的某种形式，与该事物的早期形式或同一事物的其他形式略有不同
example_zh: 某物的某个版本，该软件包的最新版本

definition: a person who has been attacked, injured or killed as the result of a crime, a disease, an accident, etc.
example: shooting/murder victims
definition_zh: 因犯罪、疾病、事故等原因而遭到袭击、受伤或死亡的人。
example_zh: 枪击/谋杀受害者

definition: to think about somebody/something in a particular way
example: view somebody/something + adv./prep., How do you view your position within the company?
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式看待某人/某事
example_zh: 如何看待某人/某事 + 副词/介词，你如何看待自己在公司中的职位？

definition: a person watching television or a video on the internet
example: The programme attracted millions of viewers.
definition_zh: 正在看电视或上网看视频的人
example_zh: 该节目吸引了数百万观众。

definition: involving or caused by physical force that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
example: violent crime/criminals
definition_zh: 涉及或由旨在伤害或杀害他人的武力所引起
example_zh: 暴力犯罪/罪犯

definition: a person who does a job without being paid for it
example: Schools need volunteers to help children to read.
definition_zh: 不为报酬而从事某项工作的人
example_zh: 学校需要志愿者来帮助孩子们学习阅读。

definition: to offer to do something without being forced to do it or without getting paid for it
example: He has been volunteering for 11 years now.
definition_zh: 主动提出做某事，既不是被迫的，也不是为了获得报酬
example_zh: 他做志愿者已经11年了。

definition: a formal choice that you make in an election or at a meeting in order to choose somebody or decide something
example: to win/lose votes
definition_zh: 你在选举或会议中为选出某人或决定某事而做出的正式选择
example_zh: 赢得/失去选票

definition: to show formally by marking a paper, raising your hand, using a voting machine, etc. which person you want to win an election, or which plan or idea you support
example: How did you vote at the last election?
definition_zh: 通过批改试卷、举手、使用投票机等方式，正式表明自己希望谁在选举中获胜，或者支持哪项计划或想法
example_zh: 上次选举中你是怎么投票的？

definition: to make something/somebody warm or warmer; to become warm or warmer
example: warm something/somebody/yourself, Come in and warm yourself by the fire.
definition_zh: 使某物/某人变暖或更暖；变得温暖或更温暖
example_zh: 给某物/某人/自己取暖，进来坐在火炉边暖和暖和吧。

definition: to tell somebody about something, especially something dangerous or unpleasant that is likely to happen, so that they can avoid it
example: warn somebody, I tried to warn him, but he wouldn't listen.
definition_zh: 向某人告知某事，尤其是可能发生的危险或不愉快的事情，以便对方能够加以避免
example_zh: 警告某人，我试着警告过他，但他就是不听。

definition: a statement, an event, etc. telling somebody that something bad or unpleasant may happen in the future so that they can try to avoid it
example: I had absolutely no warning.
definition_zh: 一种陈述、事件等，旨在告知某人未来可能会发生某些糟糕或不愉快的事情，以便其设法加以避免
example_zh: 我完全没有预感。

definition: no longer needed for a particular process and therefore thrown away
example: the disposal of waste material
definition_zh: 不再被特定流程所需要，因此被丢弃
example_zh: 废料的处置

definition: the act of using something in a careless or unnecessary way, causing it to be lost or destroyed
example: I hate unnecessary waste.
definition_zh: 指以粗心大意或不必要的方式使用某物，导致其丢失或损毁的行为
example_zh: 我讨厌不必要的浪费。

definition: to use more of something than is necessary or useful
example: waste something, Stop wasting time and just get on with it!
definition_zh: 指使用某物的数量超过必要或有用的程度
example_zh: 别浪费什么了，别再浪费时间了，赶紧动手吧！

definition: to pour water on plants, etc.
example: to water the plants/garden
definition_zh: 给植物浇水等。
example_zh: 给植物/花园浇水

definition: to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air in order to attract attention, say hello, etc.
example: The people on the bus waved and we waved back.
definition_zh: 在空中左右摆动手或手臂，以引起注意、打招呼等。
example_zh: 公交车上的乘客向我们挥手，我们也向他们挥手。

definition: an object such as a knife, gun, bomb, etc. that is used for fighting or attacking somebody
example: Modern nuclear weapons are much more destructive than either biological or chemical weapons.
definition_zh: 用于战斗或攻击他人的物品，例如刀、枪、炸弹等
example_zh: 现代核武器的破坏力远胜于生物武器或化学武器。

definition: to have a particular weight
example: How much do you weigh (= how heavy are you)?
definition_zh: 具有特定的重量
example_zh: 你体重多少（=你有多重）？

definition: located in the west or facing west
example: western Spain
definition_zh: 位于西部或朝西
example_zh: 西班牙西部

definition: any or every; anything or everything
example: Take whatever action is needed.
definition_zh: 任何或每一个；任何东西或所有东西
example_zh: 采取一切必要的措施。

definition: any or every; anything or everything
example: Take whatever action is needed.
definition_zh: 任何或每一个；任何东西或所有东西
example_zh: 采取一切必要的措施。

definition: at any time that; on any occasion that
example: You can ask for help whenever you need it.
definition_zh: 在任何时候；在任何情况下
example_zh: 只要你需要，随时都可以寻求帮助。

definition: used to express a doubt or choice between two possibilities
example: He seemed undecided whether to go or stay.
definition_zh: 用于表达怀疑或在两种可能性之间做出选择
example_zh: 他似乎在犹豫是走还是留。

definition: a period of time
example: for a while, I only stayed for a short while.
definition_zh: 一段时间
example_zh: 有一阵子，我只待了一小会儿。

definition: all that there is of something
example: The scheme would cover the whole of the UK.
definition_zh: 某事物的全部
example_zh: 该计划将覆盖整个英国。

definition: the ability to control your thoughts and actions in order to achieve what you want to do; a strong and determined desire to do something that you want to do
example: to have a strong will
definition_zh: 为了实现自己的目标而控制自己的思想和行为的能力；对做自己想做的事情怀有强烈而坚定的愿望
example_zh: 意志坚定

definition: a victory in a game, contest, etc.
example: two wins and three defeats
definition_zh: 在比赛、竞赛等中的胜利。
example_zh: 两胜三负

definition: one of the parts of the body of a bird, insect or bat that it uses for flying
example: The swan flapped its wings noisily.
definition_zh: 鸟类、昆虫或蝙蝠身体上用于飞行的部位之一
example_zh: 天鹅扇动翅膀，发出嘈杂的声音。

definition: before a particular period of time has passed; during a particular period of time
example: You should receive a reply within seven days.
definition_zh: 在特定时间段过去之前；在特定时间段内
example_zh: 您应在七天内收到回复。

definition: a feeling of surprise and pleasure that you have when you see or experience something beautiful, unusual or unexpected
example: He retained a childlike sense of wonder.
definition_zh: 当你看到或体验到某件美丽、新奇或出乎意料的事物时所产生的那种惊喜与愉悦之情
example_zh: 他始终保留着一种孩童般的惊奇感。

definition: to think about something and try to decide what is true, what will happen, what you should do, etc.
example: ‘Why do you want to know?’ ‘No particular reason. I was just wondering.’
definition_zh: 思考某件事，并试图判断什么是真实的、将会发生什么、自己应该怎么做等等。
example_zh: “你为什么想知道？”“没什么特别的原因。我只是好奇罢了。”

definition: the soft hair that covers the body of sheep and some other animals
example: Sheep were kept for their wool and meat.
definition_zh: 覆盖在绵羊及其他某些动物体表上的柔软毛发
example_zh: 养羊是为了获取羊毛和羊肉。

definition: affecting all parts of the world
example: an increase in worldwide sales
definition_zh: 影响世界各地
example_zh: 全球销售额的增长

definition: affecting all parts of the world
example: an increase in worldwide sales
definition_zh: 影响世界各地
example_zh: 全球销售额的增长

definition: the state of worrying about something
example: The threat of losing their jobs is a constant source of worry to them.
definition_zh: 对某事感到担忧的状态
example_zh: 失业的威胁让他们始终提心吊胆。

definition: less well
example: Working-class children fared rather worse.
definition_zh: 不太好
example_zh: 工人阶级的孩子情况则要差得多。

definition: most badly or seriously
example: He was voted the worst dressed celebrity.
definition_zh: 最严重或最严重地
example_zh: 他被票选为着装最差的名人。

definition: having a value in money, etc.
example: Our house is worth about £100 000.
definition_zh: 具有金钱等价值。
example_zh: 我们家的房子价值约10万英镑。

definition: expressed in writing rather than in speech
example: Having a written record of what I've done is very valuable.
definition_zh: 以书面形式而非口头形式表达
example_zh: 将自己做过的事情记录下来，非常有价值。

definition: in a way that produces a result that is not correct or that you do not want
example: My name is spelt wrong.
definition_zh: 以一种会导致结果不正确或不符合你期望的方式
example_zh: 我的名字拼写错了。

definition: a piece of land next to or around your house where you can grow flowers, fruit, vegetables, etc., usually with a lawn (= an area of grass)
example: They have a gorgeous old oak tree in their front yard.
definition_zh: 你家旁边或周围的一块地，可以在上面种植花卉、水果、蔬菜等，通常还带有一片草坪（即一片长满草的区域）
example_zh: 他们家前院有一棵壮丽的老橡树。

definition: young people considered as a group
example: It's a movie that will appeal to the young.
definition_zh: 作为一个群体的年轻人
example_zh: 这是一部会吸引年轻观众的电影。

definition: the time of life when a person is young, especially the time before a child becomes an adult
example: in somebody's youth, He had been a talented musician in his youth.
definition_zh: 人年轻时的阶段，尤其是孩子尚未成年之前的时期
example_zh: 在他年轻的时候，他曾是一位才华横溢的音乐家。
